Policy 
Dear Clients,

▫️ All appointments are scheduled in advance. I do not accept same-day bookings.

▫️ Please plan your trip ahead of time. If you are more than 20 minutes late, your appointment will be automatically canceled, and a 50% late cancellation fee will be charged.

▫️ If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, and I still have time to see you, only a natural single-color coating without design will be possible.

▫️ If you’re unable to attend your appointment, please notify me as early as possible so we can reschedule at a convenient time.

▫️ I kindly ask that you come alone to your appointment — please do not bring friends, children, partners, or any other guests.

▫️ Please avoid applying hand creams, lotions, or oils before your appointment, as these can interfere with cuticle preparation and reduce the durability of the coating.

Thank you!
